blocks.html: Territory Planning is the strategic allocation of accounts, geographic regions, or industry segments among sales representatives to maximize coverage, efficiency, and revenue potential.

Territory planning ensures sales teams are assigned markets fairly and effectively. It balances workloads, reduces overlap, and helps organizations capture more opportunities while improving rep productivity.

items.html: Dividing accounts by geography, industry, or size
Assigning territories based on rep capacity and experience
Analyzing market potential and opportunity density

blocks.html: Strong territory plans create clearer ownership and accountability.
A company assigns one sales rep to western India manufacturing accounts and another to southern India logistics accounts to improve specialization and coverage.
Territory Planning is a strategic method of assigning markets and accounts to sales teams for better efficiency and growth.
Maximize every sales opportunity. MarketJoy helps businesses design smart territory plans that improve coverage and drive revenue results.
